scope: Production Safety Gate for verified evidence selection, provenance/rights safety, missing-evidence detection and hearing routing. Trust copy generation remains out of scope.
decision: validate conversion goal and primary objections
require complete provenance and verification date
require production-cleared rights for visual evidence
classify eligible evidence and placement candidates
detect missing evidence and blocked claims
require production-eligible usage status when invoked by the production pipeline

fallback.research_only_evidence: Not production approved; route to hearing or permission review.

integration.production_mode: Safety input mandatory; no input is PAGE_BLOCK.
integration.research_mode: May inspect research-only records; output_status is NOT_PRODUCTION_APPROVED.
integration.test_mode: Fixtures allowed for tests only; never delivery evidence.

invariants: Production output evidence_manifest contains only Safety-selected production-eligible records.
No raw unsupported customer-facing claim is approved.
Missing Safety input or selector failure never produces Production output.
